global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu and crisp menma. A single nori sheet rests atop, with garnishes centered, all in a white bowl with blue patterns, set against a dark, softly lit wooden surface.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and soft light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue geometric patterned rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: The miso broth is amber-brown, glossy, and surrounds noodles with visible green onions and a yellow egg yolk garnish.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface details and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows pinkish-brown hue, tender texture, irregular shape, and slightly uneven surface with faint marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear translucent, pale brown, with layered, slightly curled texture and faint green specks on their surface.
